description: Test selection strategy: layers, risk mapping, dimensions, coverage strategies.
layer_rule: Use the cheapest layer that can falsify the requirement. Mocked E2E alone cannot verify the actual backend.

risk_to_test.test: Independent input/output examples, invariants, property tests
Model-based command sequences with saved seeds and shrunk failures
Controlled interleavings: request A, request B, resolve B, resolve A
Concurrent and retried calls against real transaction/uniqueness
Same operation with unauthorized resource and tenant combinations
Thin real-stack smoke: auth, API, database, queue/worker, UI refresh
Promoted visual baseline, fixed fonts/data/environment, meaningful viewports

dimension_rule: Enumerate relevant dimensions. Classify each. Mark irrelevant dimensions with explicit reasons.
coverage_rule: Pairwise is NOT sufficient for authorization or transactional correctness.
anti_patterns: Copying production selector into test oracle (circular test)
Mocking everything in an integration test
Testing only happy path for security-relevant operations
Treating test count as quality metric
Re-running flaky test until green and calling it verified

principles.principle: Minimum two assertions per critical function. Each dimension should produce at least boundary + invariant assertions.
Test size = resource constraint, not type. Small: 1 thread, no I/O, <1s. Medium: localhost, <5min. Large: multi-machine, <15min.
80/15/5 pyramid. Push tests down unless the requirement genuinely needs a higher layer.
Deterministic quality gates run offline. Schema, security, structural checks that either pass or don't.
Every endpoint receiving an object ID must validate ownership. Test matrix: own resource, other tenant, nonexistent, sequential probe.

dual_assertion_rule: Each critical invariant should have both a runtime assertion AND a static/structural assertion. One proves current behavior; the other proves the code cannot silently regress.

exemplars.pattern: Systematic boundary/equivalence partitioning for IBAN validation. Each boundary value isolates exactly one dimension. Docstrings explain why the wrong check would pass.
Hash pinned against external C# expression line numbers, not against the Python implementation. Tests parity with the oracle, not self-consistency.
Replays Python engine against JSON snapshots from running C# server. External oracle. Excluded accounts documented with 5-point evidence trail and separately asserted still written.
Pins unobservable phantom field through the one stored figure computed from it. Direct assertion on phantom proves nothing; indirect assertion through dependent value does.
Two independent proofs: runtime (only low-privilege secret requested) AND static source scan (no line fetches high-privilege secret name). NASA Rule 5 in practice.
Orchestration tested separately from effects. Stub records (method_name, status_at_call_time) - the property no other test sees.
Thread-safety of singleton via real threading.Barrier. 8 threads contend, assert exactly 1 construction.
1580-line convention enforcement test. Sweeps every lifecycle hook, verifies every substantive hook ported. Positive controls (strip evidence, pairs come back). Discovered 4 real defects.
Structural test: no two routes match the same URL for the same method. Born from real incident. Latent overlap set pinned in both directions.
DDL tested from both directions: no phantom column created AND every non-phantom column still is. Nullability verified per column against generator rules.
